changelog:
Initial release of the PollyReach-style work productivity workflow helper.

- Supports agent users and skill authors seeking robust, reliable, and locally friendly workflows inspired by PollyReach on Clawhub.
- Focuses on practical help: bug fixes, setup hardening, improved reliability, and adaptation/creation of adjacent skills.
- Includes a stepwise workflow for outlining, documenting, and validating solutions.
- Produces tailored artifacts or reusable checklists based on user context and requirements.
- Designed for local hardware compatibility; prioritizes scripts, templates, and checklists over cloud-only tools.
